# Test plan for .github/workflows/fork-test-runner.yml (fork-only; never merged upstream).
# One row per change under review. Pipe-separated, blank lines and # comments ignored.
#
#   branch | test file | source file | -k expression | suite dir ("-") | base ref (default main)
#
# The base ref is resolved as origin/<base> first, then verbatim. Prefer a
# branch-relative rev such as <branch>~2 over a raw SHA. Before 2026-09-07 a
# raw SHA silently failed to check out and BEFORE ran against main instead.
#
# The runner checks out <branch>'s test file on top of main and runs the -k
# selection (expected red), then checks out the branch and runs the whole file
# (expected green). If a suite dir is given it runs `pytest -m cpu_test <dir>`
# on main and on the branch so unrelated environment failures are visible as
# identical on both sides.

# scoping does not exist on main at all.
